# Olivabot

> Olivabot B.V. (KVK 94493200, Amsterdam) writes a feasibility study in one week: new technology, or an add-on to a product you already have. €1,500. Email services@olivabot.com to book a call.

Olivabot is a Dutch BV. Work is remote, invoiced from the Netherlands, for clients in the EU. We do not use LinkedIn. The first step is a feasibility study, not a build.

## Hire

- [Feasibility study](https://olivabot.com/en/services/feasibility.html): new technology, or an add-on to an existing product, €1,500, delivered in one week
- [Contact](https://olivabot.com/en/contact.html): email services@olivabot.com to book a call
- [Services](https://olivabot.com/en/services.html): the study, then prototypes and consulting
- [Prototypes](https://olivabot.com/en/services/prototype.html): a first version, enough to learn from
- [Consulting](https://olivabot.com/en/services/consulting.html): a conversation, then a written note on what to do next

## Projects

- [Projects](https://olivabot.com/en/projects.html): Madglove Sense, Mycofarming Mycosense, Gibbon Bot, and research
- [Madglove Sense](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/madglove-sense.html): sensors and firmware for a rehabilitation glove
- [Mycosense](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/mycosense.html): LoRaWAN monitoring for Mycofarming
